column1: # The slow-gate scan's committed corpus: TestSlowGateScanCorpus reads every row.
# id
# tree:    a fixture root beside this file (its Makefile and its Go packages).
# check:   static  the unarmed-line audit; subject is the tree's one recipe
#                  target, want the scan's exit code (1 refused, 0 proven).
#          credit  the coverage accounting; subject is pkg.Test, want the make
#                  target credited with running it, - for none.
#          coverage  the whole accounting over a committed go test -json
#                  transcript; subject is transcript:go-exit, with :blocked
#                  when the table's path is taken by a directory; want the
#                  exit code (the tree is copied to a scratch directory first).
#          gated   the gated packages; subject is -, want them space-separated,
#                  - for a tree the scan refuses as holding none.
# F-030: -race builds under the race tag, so a test behind //go:build !race is
# not built; an unarmed line that selects only it runs no tests, and an armed
# race line is not credited with it.
F-030-race-unarmed
F-030-race-unarmed-control
F-030-race-credit
F-030-race-credit-control
# F-219: go test rewrites a space in a selector to _, so -skip 'TestWin Codec'
# removes TestWin_Codec; the line that skips it is not credited with it.
F-219-space-skip
F-219-space-skip-control
# F-233: a transcript cut at an event boundary, or written by a go test that
# exited nonzero, proves nothing; the whole stream from a clean run does.
F-233-cut-transcript
F-233-go-exit
F-233-control
# F-234: a coverage table that cannot be written is a red verdict.
F-234-table-blocked
# F-241: testdata is not a package, and the call spelled in a comment or a
# string is not a call.
F-241-not-built
F-241-control
